turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did Owen get a zero before anyone called me?
Can I ask something off the record?
Nothing in this room is off the record. Why did Owen get a zero before anyone called me?
When was the last time you actually sat with him while he did homework?
I'm not the one being questioned, and his home is not on the table. You still haven't told me why the zero went in first.
Because in my experience, kids who cheat have parents who are too busy to notice.
My son never lies. "Too busy to notice": is that what you're calling me, Hale? Then show me what you have on Owen, in writing.
